pr.title: feat(source): honor general.backfill on gitlab and gitea too
pr.body:
Closes #91. Honor `general.backfill` on GitLab and Gitea too.

`general.backfill` (#15) only affected GitHub — a global-looking knob silently ignored by the other two sources.

### Change
- **Gitea**: its new involved-PR sweep (#95) runs the forge diff, so it honors `first_sight_backfill` the same way GitHub does — first-run detection + `sweep_backfill` on the open sweep.
- **GitLab**: its `mr_diff` baselined silently on first sight; now `MrContext.first_sight_backfill` lets `all_open` surface the MR's derivable activity on the first poll instead. `none`/`review_requests` stay silent (review requests come from the todos path, so `mr_diff` has none to backfill).

All three sources now read `config.general.backfill`; starter-config comment updated to say it applies to every source.

### Tests
GitLab `all_open_backfill_surfaces_on_first_sight` (default baselines silently; `all_open` fires `Merged` on first sight). Gitea rides the existing forge diff-mode tests + the #95 sweep path.

seed.mutation: step left out of one of two parallel paths

expected.description: The Gitea source never writes the backfilled cursor that GitLab writes after its first poll, so every poll counts as the first run: with backfill = none a newly involved PR is baselined silently on every poll and its recent activity is never surfaced, and with all_open each new PR replays its whole history.
